Building on our board game sales and the enthusiastic acceptance by players, as well as broad positive media coverage, Time for Two’s games are now available as digital browser games.

Behind the Brand

Barbara and Michael Jonas, selected by People magazine as “One of America’s Most Romantic Couples,” launched Time for Two in 1981.

They created games and books centered on romance, laughter, intimacy, and conversation. They also authored The Book of Love, Laughter & Romance, which sold more than 130,000 copies.

An Enchanting

A game of Love, Laughter & Romance

An Enchanting Evening™ is a playfully intimate game for a couple. Enjoy the game, and each other, at any level of intimacy that’s comfortable and fun for both of you.

The Game sets the stage… The players make it An Enchanting Evening™.

Before you play: plan a private time and place — not the kitchen table. Soft lighting, candles, music, and some of your favorite things to eat and drink close at hand.
